item.title: Finding housing in Germany can be challenging, especially when you are new to...
item.description:
Finding housing in Germany can be challenging, especially when you are new to the system. To support international students, TU Darmstadt is offering online webinars that explain how to search for accommodation, where to look, and what to watch out for during the process.

During the session, you will learn about common housing options, useful platforms, and practical tips for navigating the housing market in Darmstadt.

When: Thursday, 10th September, 1 pm (CEST)

More information and webinar access:
http://www.tu-darmstadt.de/housing-assist

item.title: New course: Professional German B2 (Berufsbezogener Deutschkurs)
item.description:
New course: Professional German B2 (Berufsbezogener Deutschkurs)
 
Finishing your English-taught degree and planning to work in Germany? This new course from International Career Service Rhein-Main is built specifically for you, focused on job applications, interviews, and communication in a German workplace.

28 September – 15 December 2026
Hybrid: 2 in-person days per week (Mon & Tue, 14:00–17:30) + e-learning, around 20h/week total
Requirement: B1 German certificate
Registration deadline: 10 September 2026

Questions? Join the online info session on Monday, 7 September, 14:00.
 
Register here: https://www.icsrm.hrz.tu-darmstadt.de/product/6a7b12971c3bfe0093b53c1d
More details in the flyer: https://ics-rm.de/wp-content/uploads/2026/08/Flyer-Deutschkurs-WiSe26_final.pdf

item.title: Your X Weeks are here!
item.description:
Your X Weeks are here!
Welcome to TU Darmstadt, exchange students! From the Welcome Day to various socio-cultural events, these first days are all about getting you settled, informed, and connected before the semester kicks off.
Meet fellow students, get answers to your questions, pick up your welcome bag, and start exploring everything Darmstadt has to offer. And don't forget, ISS and their @tutor_international team is here to help you feel at home and make new friends along the way.
Campus Stadtmitte, S1|03
2 to 3 September 2026
We can't wait to meet you! Check out our X-Weeks website www.tu-darmstadt.de/xweeks for more info

item.title: 📚🌍 Scholarship for More Equal Opportunities!
item.description:
📚🌍 Scholarship for More Equal Opportunities!
The International Student Services at TU Darmstadt are awarding the DAAD-Scholarship, providing financial support to international students. This includes students with a refugee background, disabilities and/or chronic illnesses, gender-specific challenges, or caregiving responsibilities. Apply now!

🗓 Application deadline: 10 September 2026.
More info at: www.tu-darmstadt.de/financial-assistance

📚🌍 Stipendium für mehr Chancengerechtigkeit!
Die International Student Services der TU Darmstadt vergeben das DAAD-Stipendium, das internationale Studierende finanziell unterstützt. Dazu gehören Studierende mit Fluchthintergrund, Behinderung und/oder chronischer Erkrankung, geschlechtsspezifischen Herausforderungen oder Betreuungspflichten. Jetzt bewerben!

🗓 Bewerbungsfrist: 10. September 2026.
Mehr Infos unter: www.tu-darmstadt.de/financial-assistance

item.title: Exam season is here, and we know it's a lot.
item.description:
Exam season is here, and we know it's a lot.
 
Whether you're juggling multiple subjects, studying in your second or third language, or just feeling the pressure, you're not alone. Here are a few evidence-backed tips to help you study smarter, not just longer.

The biggest one? Sleep. Please sleep. No amount of last-minute cramming makes up for a brain running on empty.

You've put in the work. Now trust the process.
